heroHeadline: Every connection, a journey worth remembering.
heroSupport: Selective discovery, a private couple space for memories, and optional companionship — with no promise of the perfect person, and no couple space opened from a single like.
pillarsSupport: Choose the path that fits — Couple Space does not require dating first.
pillarFindBody: Deeper profiles, selective discovery, likes and chat when both people agree.
pillarCoupleBody: A private space after a two-sided invite: memory map, milestones, and wishes.
pillarCompanionBody: Optional advisory and Lifestyle services — fees and scope shown before you confirm.
howSupport: Four clear steps — only ready capabilities are presented as active.
howStep1Body: Confirm email and accept terms and privacy.
howStep2Body: Discover, invite a partner into Couple Space, or explore Lifestyle.
howStep3Body: A mutual match opens chat; Couple Space opens only after both accept an invite.
howStep4Body: Save memories, plan DEMO dates, or use AI helpers with clear consent.
aiSupport: Profile, date, and style suggestions — no psychological diagnosis, no “compatibility %”.
aiCoachBody: Draft profile tips you preview before saving.
aiDateBody: Venue and theme ideas from clearly labeled DEMO catalog items.
aiGiftBody: Occasion-based ideas — no private partner data without opt-in.
couplePreviewSupport: Marketing illustration only — no real couple maps, photos, or private notes.
lifestyleSupport: Gifts, fashion, beauty, venues, travel, and safety — DEMO-labeled sample catalog in staging.
lifestyleDemoBadge: DEMO · no real booking or payment
trustSupport: Block and report are available; you control your data. DeepSafe is not a 24/7 emergency dispatch service.
trustBlockBody: Cut contact and report inappropriate behavior from inside the app.
trustPrivacyBody: Private journals and precise GPS are not used in matching.
trustAdultBody: The service is for people 18 years and older.
faqSupport: Answers for guests — public product information only.
finalCtaSupport: Create a free account. Mobile app store links appear when verified.
metaTitle: DeepMatch — Every connection, a journey worth remembering
